blocks.code:
class StorageError extends Error {
  readonly source: '@migaia/storage-web'
  readonly code: IStorageErrorCode
  readonly backend?: IBackendKind
  readonly key?: string | IStorageKey
  readonly existingChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
  readonly attemptedChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
  readonly extensionStage?: 'schema' | 'codec' | 'migration' | 'comparator' | 'diagnostic'
  readonly operation?: string
  constructor(
    code: IStorageErrorCode,
    details?: {
      readonly backend?: IBackendKind
      readonly key?: string | IStorageKey
      readonly existingChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
      readonly attemptedChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
      readonly extensionStage?: 'schema' | 'codec' | 'migration' | 'comparator' | 'diagnostic'
      readonly operation?: string
      readonly cause?: unknown
    },
    message?: string
  )
}

blocks.text: `source` 恒为 `'@migaia/storage-web'`；`cause` 恒保留原始异常，永不改写 `message`；实例在构造后立即 `Object.freeze`。
`STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE` 是上述稳定 source 的唯一公开常量。`StorageErrorText` 是包维护的稳定错误文本/文本工厂集合，主要供实现自定义 backend、codec 或诊断适配器时复用；业务分支仍应比较 `(source, code)`，不要依赖 message 文本。
全部错误码（`StorageErrorCode`）：

rows: 存储后端不可用：隐私模式探测失败、`localStorageHost`/IndexedDB/`document` 被禁用或缺失
写入命中浏览器配额上限
序列化后的 cookie 值超过单值 4KB 上限
序列化失败（`JSON.stringify` 抛错、codec encode 非预期输出、`structuredClone` 写失败）
反序列化失败（`JSON.parse` 抛错、envelope 结构非法、codec decode 非预期输出）
IndexedDB 事务创建/提交失败，或事务回调抛出非 `StorageError` 异常
value/bytes/record 三通道逻辑 key 冲突且未指定 `conflictPolicy: 'replace'`
entity envelope `__v` 或 IndexedDB schema 版本高于当前代码所知的版本
扩展点（schema/codec/namespaceCodec/comparator/diagnostic）抛出了未归类的异常
事务提交时 read revision 或 global epoch 已变（并发写冲突，可重试）
Cookie 写入后读回不可见
Cookie 同名多 scope 可见，无法确定目标值归属
Web adapter 专有输入/配置校验失败（选项形状、cookie scope、IndexedDB store 名等）

blocks.text: V4 索引、Host 与 reactive 追加错误码：

rows: sidecar 指向的 authoritative record 不存在；修复或重建索引。
unique key 已属于另一记录；修改值或删除竞争记录后重试。
分页期间 epoch 改变；从头重启查询。
回填与失败状态保存同时失败；检查原生 AggregateError 的 cause/errors 后重试。
owner/generation/checkpoint 已过期；重新取得 repository session 后重试。
使用不同 ID，或等待既有安装完成。
安装并选择精确 ID；没有隐式 default。
修复 plugin/store 契约或伪造 handle。
检查 `cause`；失败 batch 未发布，可修复后重试。
等当前安装 batch settle 后显式重试。
Host 已 terminal；创建新 Host。
Host 仍 terminal；检查 aggregate cleanup errors。
query 已 terminal；创建新 query。
修复 feature 与 opaque backend kind 的绑定。
修复未知、重复或循环 feature graph。
安装 reactive plugin 后再创建 query。
选择已安装且 reactive 的 backend ID。
观察 query error；后续 invalidation/poll 可触发恢复。
adapter 已 terminal；检查 cleanup errors。
backend 已 terminal；检查 quiescence/transport cleanup errors。

blocks.text: `StorageError`｜3 秒上手 —— 本包（`@migaia/storage-web`）专有失败的统一类型：
`source` 恒为 `'@migaia/storage-web'`；`cause` 恒保留原始异常，永不改写 `message`。

`StorageErrorCode` 覆盖 backend、codec/schema、事务、二级索引、Host/plugin 和 reactive 生命周期失败。常用码包括 `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`、`DUPLICATE_KEY`、`TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`、`INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`、`INDEX_QUERY_INVALIDATED`、`BACKEND_INSTALL_FAILED`、`STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`、`LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSED` 与 `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_FAILED`；完整清单和恢复动作见 USEGUIDE。

契约级错误直接从 `@migaia/storage-contract` 导入，storage-web 根不转出：`StorageContractError`（`source: '@migaia/storage-contract'`）、`StorageContractErrorCode`（`invalidArgument`/`invalidKey`/`unsupported`/`disposed`/`aborted`）、`isStorageContractError` 类型守卫。两类错误都保留 `cause` 链。

symbols.core:
entityUniqueSnapshotChanged: The KV raw-text snapshot changed during preparation; `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` asks the caller to retry the complete write.
entityMigrationGraphIncomplete: Entity construction omitted an upgrade step from 2 through the current version; correct the graph before retrying.
standardSchemaIssuesInvalid: A Standard Schema implementation returned malformed issue entries rather than message-bearing objects.
namespaceCodecEncodeInvalid: A namespace encoder returned a non-string physical key.
namespaceCodecDecodeInvalid: A namespace decoder returned neither a string key nor undefined for another namespace.
webStorageInjectionInvalid: Injected Web Storage lacks part of the required storage interface.
webStorageLengthInvalid: The live Web Storage length is not a nonnegative safe integer.
webStorageKeyInvalid: Live Web Storage enumeration did not provide a string key for a visible index.
webStorageKeyDuplicate: Live Web Storage enumeration returned the same physical key more than once.
indexedDbChangeHintKeyInvalid: An IndexedDB coordination hint contains an undecodable storage key.
indexedDbUpgradeTransactionMissing: An IndexedDB upgrade event omitted the platform-owned upgrade transaction.
cookieDocumentBecameInvalid: An admitted cookie document stopped exposing its cookie property as a string.
entityComparatorInvalid: An entity ordering callback returned an invalid comparison number.
storageKeyDecodeLimitExceeded: An encoded key exceeded the supported decode depth or node limits.
storageKeyWireInvalid: An encoded key is not the required two-slot wire tuple.
storageKeyBinaryTooLarge: A binary storage key exceeds the public encoded-key size bound.
storageKeyWireTagInvalid: An encoded storage key uses an unknown wire type tag.
backendIdInvalid: A backend identifier violates the registration name grammar before mutation.
backendDuplicate: A backend identifier is already installed or duplicated in the install batch.
backendNotInstalled: A valid backend identifier has no installed registry entry.
backendPluginInvalid: A backend plugin or returned store violates its public contract.
backendInstallFailed: Backend factory creation, preparation or PluginHost installation failed.
storageHostBusy: A host mutation was requested while another install batch was running.
storageHostDisposed: A host operation ran after the host sealed or reached terminal disposal.
storageHostDisposeFailed: Several host cleanup failures are summarized while disposal remains terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: Several live-query cleanup failures are summarized after disposal.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: A reactive provider, feature or adapter descriptor has an invalid shape.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: Reactive feature topology has an unknown dependency, duplicate or cycle.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: A live-query service was requested before installing its reactive plugin.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: The requested backend has no installed reactive adapter.
reactiveAdapterFailed: An adapter event, polling operation or authoritative read failed recoverably.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: Reactive adapter or service cleanup produced aggregated failures.
liveQueryFailed: A live-query extension callback failed and its original cause is retained.
backendDisposeFailed: Direct backend cleanup failed and is reported through the storage boundary.
indexOrphan: An index sidecar row has no authoritative entity record.
indexQueryInvalidated: Concurrent mutation invalidated a native paged index query.
liveQueryDisposed: A permanently disposed live query was used again and must be recreated.
indexBackfillStale: The index backfill handle is stale and the query must retry.
indexBackfillProjectionTooLarge: Backfill projection work exceeded its fixed bound before sidecar writes.
indexBackfillDecodedTooLarge: Decoded backfill payload exceeded its fixed bound before issuing a partial batch.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Stable message texts used by this package, for custom backends and codecs that want the same wording; branch on `code`, not on text.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StorageErrorText from @migaia/storage-web, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StorageErrorText when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StorageErrorText does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.content:
entityUniqueSnapshotChanged: The KV raw-text snapshot changed during preparation; `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` asks the caller to retry the complete write.
entityMigrationGraphIncomplete: Entity construction omitted an upgrade step from 2 through the current version; correct the graph before retrying.
standardSchemaIssuesInvalid: A Standard Schema implementation returned malformed issue entries rather than message-bearing objects.
namespaceCodecEncodeInvalid: A namespace encoder returned a non-string physical key.
namespaceCodecDecodeInvalid: A namespace decoder returned neither a string key nor undefined for another namespace.
webStorageInjectionInvalid: Injected Web Storage lacks part of the required storage interface.
webStorageLengthInvalid: The live Web Storage length is not a nonnegative safe integer.
webStorageKeyInvalid: Live Web Storage enumeration did not provide a string key for a visible index.
webStorageKeyDuplicate: Live Web Storage enumeration returned the same physical key more than once.
indexedDbChangeHintKeyInvalid: An IndexedDB coordination hint contains an undecodable storage key.
indexedDbUpgradeTransactionMissing: An IndexedDB upgrade event omitted the platform-owned upgrade transaction.
cookieDocumentBecameInvalid: An admitted cookie document stopped exposing its cookie property as a string.
entityComparatorInvalid: An entity ordering callback returned an invalid comparison number.
storageKeyDecodeLimitExceeded: An encoded key exceeded the supported decode depth or node limits.
storageKeyWireInvalid: An encoded key is not the required two-slot wire tuple.
storageKeyBinaryTooLarge: A binary storage key exceeds the public encoded-key size bound.
storageKeyWireTagInvalid: An encoded storage key uses an unknown wire type tag.
backendIdInvalid: A backend identifier violates the registration name grammar before mutation.
backendDuplicate: A backend identifier is already installed or duplicated in the install batch.
backendNotInstalled: A valid backend identifier has no installed registry entry.
backendPluginInvalid: A backend plugin or returned store violates its public contract.
backendInstallFailed: Backend factory creation, preparation or PluginHost installation failed.
storageHostBusy: A host mutation was requested while another install batch was running.
storageHostDisposed: A host operation ran after the host sealed or reached terminal disposal.
storageHostDisposeFailed: Several host cleanup failures are summarized while disposal remains terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: Several live-query cleanup failures are summarized after disposal.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: A reactive provider, feature or adapter descriptor has an invalid shape.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: Reactive feature topology has an unknown dependency, duplicate or cycle.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: A live-query service was requested before installing its reactive plugin.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: The requested backend has no installed reactive adapter.
reactiveAdapterFailed: An adapter event, polling operation or authoritative read failed recoverably.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: Reactive adapter or service cleanup produced aggregated failures.
liveQueryFailed: A live-query extension callback failed and its original cause is retained.
backendDisposeFailed: Direct backend cleanup failed and is reported through the storage boundary.
indexOrphan: An index sidecar row has no authoritative entity record.
indexQueryInvalidated: Concurrent mutation invalidated a native paged index query.
liveQueryDisposed: A permanently disposed live query was used again and must be recreated.
indexBackfillStale: The index backfill handle is stale and the query must retry.
indexBackfillProjectionTooLarge: Backfill projection work exceeded its fixed bound before sidecar writes.
indexBackfillDecodedTooLarge: Decoded backfill payload exceeded its fixed bound before issuing a partial batch.

blocks.code:
class StorageError extends Error {
  readonly source: '@migaia/storage-web'
  readonly code: IStorageErrorCode
  readonly backend?: IBackendKind
  readonly key?: string | IStorageKey
  readonly existingChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
  readonly attemptedChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
  readonly extensionStage?: 'schema' | 'codec' | 'migration' | 'comparator' | 'diagnostic'
  readonly operation?: string
  constructor(
    code: IStorageErrorCode,
    details?: {
      readonly backend?: IBackendKind
      readonly key?: string | IStorageKey
      readonly existingChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
      readonly attemptedChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
      readonly extensionStage?: 'schema' | 'codec' | 'migration' | 'comparator' | 'diagnostic'
      readonly operation?: string
      readonly cause?: unknown
    },
    message?: string
  )
}

blocks.text: `source` 恒为 `'@migaia/storage-web'`；`cause` 恒保留原始异常，永不改写 `message`；实例在构造后立即 `Object.freeze`。
`STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE` 是上述稳定 source 的唯一公开常量。`StorageErrorText` 是包维护的稳定错误文本/文本工厂集合，主要供实现自定义 backend、codec 或诊断适配器时复用；业务分支仍应比较 `(source, code)`，不要依赖 message 文本。
全部错误码（`StorageErrorCode`）：

rows: 存储后端不可用：隐私模式探测失败、`localStorageHost`/IndexedDB/`document` 被禁用或缺失
写入命中浏览器配额上限
序列化后的 cookie 值超过单值 4KB 上限
序列化失败（`JSON.stringify` 抛错、codec encode 非预期输出、`structuredClone` 写失败）
反序列化失败（`JSON.parse` 抛错、envelope 结构非法、codec decode 非预期输出）
IndexedDB 事务创建/提交失败，或事务回调抛出非 `StorageError` 异常
value/bytes/record 三通道逻辑 key 冲突且未指定 `conflictPolicy: 'replace'`
entity envelope `__v` 或 IndexedDB schema 版本高于当前代码所知的版本
扩展点（schema/codec/namespaceCodec/comparator/diagnostic）抛出了未归类的异常
事务提交时 read revision 或 global epoch 已变（并发写冲突，可重试）
Cookie 写入后读回不可见
Cookie 同名多 scope 可见，无法确定目标值归属
Web adapter 专有输入/配置校验失败（选项形状、cookie scope、IndexedDB store 名等）

blocks.text: V4 索引、Host 与 reactive 追加错误码：

rows: sidecar 指向的 authoritative record 不存在；修复或重建索引。
unique key 已属于另一记录；修改值或删除竞争记录后重试。
分页期间 epoch 改变；从头重启查询。
回填与失败状态保存同时失败；检查原生 AggregateError 的 cause/errors 后重试。
owner/generation/checkpoint 已过期；重新取得 repository session 后重试。
使用不同 ID，或等待既有安装完成。
安装并选择精确 ID；没有隐式 default。
修复 plugin/store 契约或伪造 handle。
检查 `cause`；失败 batch 未发布，可修复后重试。
等当前安装 batch settle 后显式重试。
Host 已 terminal；创建新 Host。
Host 仍 terminal；检查 aggregate cleanup errors。
query 已 terminal；创建新 query。
修复 feature 与 opaque backend kind 的绑定。
修复未知、重复或循环 feature graph。
安装 reactive plugin 后再创建 query。
选择已安装且 reactive 的 backend ID。
观察 query error；后续 invalidation/poll 可触发恢复。
adapter 已 terminal；检查 cleanup errors。
backend 已 terminal；检查 quiescence/transport cleanup errors。

symbols.signature: export declare const cookiesHost: (options?: ICookiesOptions) => ISyncCapableStore<ICookieStore>;
symbols.purpose: Creates a cookie store with a fixed scope. `set(key, value, { maxAge | expires })` writes a cookie; values over 4096 bytes throw `VALUE_TOO_LARGE`; several visible scopes of one name throw `COOKIE_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS`.
symbols.core:
A cookie store with `sync`; HttpOnly cookies are invisible, so `has()` false does not prove absence.
namespace: Prefix that isolates this store; `keys()` and `clearValues()` only see this namespace.
`default`.
namespaceCodec: How namespace and key become one physical key; changing it changes the stored format.
`lengthPrefixedNamespaceCodec` (`sw1:3:app:theme`).
scope: Fixed cookie scope `{ path, domain, sameSite, secure, partitioned }` used for every write and delete; `sameSite: "none"` and `partitioned` require `secure: true`.
`{ path: "/" }`.
document: Object with a `cookie` string, for tests.
`globalThis.document`; missing throws `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`.
parameters: This const declaration has no parameters.
symbols.returns: No explicit return annotation is declared for this const.
examples:
import { cookiesHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/cookies'

const jar = cookiesHost({ namespace: 'app', scope: { path: '/', secure: true, sameSite: 'lax' } })
await jar.set('session', 'abc123', { maxAge: 3600 })
console.log(await jar.get('session')) // 'abc123'
await jar.remove('session')
console.log(await jar.get('session')) // null

await jar.set('session', 'abc123', { maxAge: 3600 })
await jar.get('session') // 'abc123'
await jar.remove('session')

blocks.text: 声明式定义一类记录（record）。`connect(store)` 把定义绑定到具体后端，产出可反复调用 `get`/`put`/`remove`/`list`/`stream`/`migrate`/`batch` 的仓储（repository）对象。同一个 definition 可以 `connect` 到多个后端，行为在两者上保持一致；同一个 `store` 实例也可以被多个 entity definition 共用（内部会把 entity 名编入实际存储 key，避免不同 entity 的同 `id` 记录互相覆盖）。
构造期校验（`validateDefinition`，任一失败均抛 `StorageError(INVALID_CONFIG)`）：

items: `name: string`（必填）—— 非空字符串，且不能以 `__` 开头（保留前缀，用于内部机制如 `__storage_web_entity_v2__`）。
`key: Extract<keyof TDomain, string>`（必填）—— 领域对象上作为主键的属性名，必须是非空字符串。
`version?: number` —— 默认 `1`；必须是正安全整数。
`schema?` —— 未提供时默认 `passthrough<TDomain>()`；提供时会用 `snapshotSchema` 校验 `name`（非空字符串）、`validate`（必须是函数）、`encode`/`decode`/`normalize`（若提供必须是函数）。

`migrations?` —— `version > 1` 时必须完整提供第 `2` 到 `version` 的每一步（每个 key 都存在且是函数），条目数必须恰好等于 `version - 1`，且每个 key 必须是 `2 <= key <= version` 的整数——缺一步、多一步、版本号越界都会抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`。这与 `runMigrations` 的“缺失即 no-op”不同：`defineEntity` 在构造期做硬校验，因为实体的迁移图一旦声明就必须完整、可预测。
`validateOnRead?: boolean` —— 默认 `true`。
`onDiagnostic?: (message: string) => void` —— 必须是函数（若提供），否则 `INVALID_CONFIG`；默认 `console.warn`。诊断回调自身抛错会被吞掉，不影响存储语义。
`defaultOrderBy?: (left, right) => number` —— 必须是函数（若提供）。

blocks.text: `codec` 选项的延迟决策：未显式提供时，`defineEntity` 本身不会默认成任何具体 codec（不能默认成 `jsonCodec`，因为结构化后端与 KV 后端的合理默认不同，且只有 `connect(store)` 时才知道实际连接的是哪种后端）。真正的默认值由 `createRepository` 在 `connect` 阶段决定：结构化后端（IndexedDB/memory，`isRecordStore(store) === true`）默认 `structuredCodec`；KV-only 后端（local/session/cookie）默认 `jsonCodec`。显式提供的 `codec` 会在 `connect` 阶段经 `selectCodec` 按后端能力选路，不会被结构化后端“绕过”默认值逻辑。

blocks.code:
type IListOptions<TRecord = unknown> = {
  readonly range?: IKeyRange
  readonly index?: never // 按索引查询时改用带 index 名的选项（IIndexedListOptions）
  readonly limit?: number
  readonly orderBy?: (left: TRecord, right: TRecord) => number
  readonly direction?: 'next' | 'prev'
  readonly onInvalid?:
    'skip' | 'throw' | ((issue: IInvalidRecordIssue<TRecord>) => 'skip' | 'throw')
}
type IInvalidRecordIssue<TRecord = unknown> = {
  readonly key: IStorageKey
  readonly raw: unknown
  readonly record?: TRecord
  readonly stage: 'decode' | 'migrate' | 'validate'
  readonly cause: unknown
}

items: `range`：作用于原始 `id` 空间（不是编排后的物理 key），经 `snapshotKeyRange` 校验。
`limit`：非负安全整数，否则抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`。

`orderBy`：未提供时使用 `defineEntity` 的 `defaultOrderBy`（若也未提供，按扫描顺序输出）。提供 `orderBy` 时内部会先缓冲全部符合 `range` 的记录、排序后再应用 `limit`——这意味着带排序的 `list`/`stream` 不是流式内存友好的，会一次性把结果集载入内存。比较函数返回非 `number` 或 `NaN` 会抛 `StorageError(EXTENSION_FAILED, { extensionStage: 'comparator', operation: 'entity.orderBy' })`。

`onInvalid`：取 `'skip'`（默认）、`'throw'`，或 `(issue) => 'skip' | 'throw'` 处理器函数；`issue.stage` 标识失败发生在解码（`decode`）、迁移（`migrate`）还是校验（`validate`）阶段。处理器返回非 `'skip'`/`'throw'` 为 `INVALID_CONFIG`；handler 自身的普通失败按 `VALIDATION_FAILED` 包装，已有 storage-family 错误保持其码与原因链。issue.stage 是记录失败阶段，不决定 handler 错误码。

扫描策略：KV-only 后端（local/session/cookie）会对全部键做一次 `keys()` 扫描后按 `entityName:` 前缀过滤，并调用一次 `onDiagnostic`（`"...list/stream on a value-only backend performs a full key scan"`）——这不是 bug，是这类后端固有的能力限制。结构化后端（IndexedDB/memory）按 entity 的 v2 前缀 range 高效扫描一遍，再额外扫描一遍全表以兼容尚未迁移的历史形态记录（`[entityName, id]`），用 `seenIds` 去重避免同一记录在两次扫描中都被 yield。
`list` 是 `stream` 的缓冲版本（`for await` 收集进数组后返回）；两者共享同一套过滤/排序/`onInvalid` 逻辑。

type IListOptions<TRecord = unknown> = {
  readonly range?: IKeyRange
  readonly index?: never // 按索引查询时改用带 index 名的选项（IIndexedListOptions）
  readonly limit?: number
  readonly orderBy?: (left: TRecord, right: TRecord) => number
  readonly direction?: 'next' | 'prev'
  readonly onInvalid?:
    'skip' | 'throw' | ((issue: IInvalidRecordIssue<TRecord>) => 'skip' | 'throw')
}
type IInvalidRecordIssue<TRecord = unknown> = {
  readonly key: IStorageKey
  readonly raw: unknown
  readonly record?: TRecord
  readonly stage: 'decode' | 'migrate' | 'validate'
  readonly cause: unknown
}

items: `range`：作用于原始 `id` 空间（不是编排后的物理 key），经 `snapshotKeyRange` 校验。
`limit`：非负安全整数，否则抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`。

`orderBy`：未提供时使用 `defineEntity` 的 `defaultOrderBy`（若也未提供，按扫描顺序输出）。提供 `orderBy` 时内部会先缓冲全部符合 `range` 的记录、排序后再应用 `limit`——这意味着带排序的 `list`/`stream` 不是流式内存友好的，会一次性把结果集载入内存。比较函数返回非 `number` 或 `NaN` 会抛 `StorageError(EXTENSION_FAILED, { extensionStage: 'comparator', operation: 'entity.orderBy' })`。

`onInvalid`：取 `'skip'`（默认）、`'throw'`，或 `(issue) => 'skip' | 'throw'` 处理器函数；`issue.stage` 标识失败发生在解码（`decode`）、迁移（`migrate`）还是校验（`validate`）阶段。处理器返回非 `'skip'`/`'throw'` 为 `INVALID_CONFIG`；handler 自身的普通失败按 `VALIDATION_FAILED` 包装，已有 storage-family 错误保持其码与原因链。issue.stage 是记录失败阶段，不决定 handler 错误码。

扫描策略：KV-only 后端（local/session/cookie）会对全部键做一次 `keys()` 扫描后按 `entityName:` 前缀过滤，并调用一次 `onDiagnostic`（`"...list/stream on a value-only backend performs a full key scan"`）——这不是 bug，是这类后端固有的能力限制。结构化后端（IndexedDB/memory）按 entity 的 v2 前缀 range 高效扫描一遍，再额外扫描一遍全表以兼容尚未迁移的历史形态记录（`[entityName, id]`），用 `seenIds` 去重避免同一记录在两次扫描中都被 yield。
`list` 是 `stream` 的缓冲版本（`for await` 收集进数组后返回）；两者共享同一套过滤/排序/`onInvalid` 逻辑。

blocks.code:
type IListOptions<TRecord = unknown> = {
  readonly range?: IKeyRange
  readonly index?: never // 按索引查询时改用带 index 名的选项（IIndexedListOptions）
  readonly limit?: number
  readonly orderBy?: (left: TRecord, right: TRecord) => number
  readonly direction?: 'next' | 'prev'
  readonly onInvalid?:
    'skip' | 'throw' | ((issue: IInvalidRecordIssue<TRecord>) => 'skip' | 'throw')
}
type IInvalidRecordIssue<TRecord = unknown> = {
  readonly key: IStorageKey
  readonly raw: unknown
  readonly record?: TRecord
  readonly stage: 'decode' | 'migrate' | 'validate'
  readonly cause: unknown
}

items: `range`：作用于原始 `id` 空间（不是编排后的物理 key），经 `snapshotKeyRange` 校验。
`limit`：非负安全整数，否则抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`。

`orderBy`：未提供时使用 `defineEntity` 的 `defaultOrderBy`（若也未提供，按扫描顺序输出）。提供 `orderBy` 时内部会先缓冲全部符合 `range` 的记录、排序后再应用 `limit`——这意味着带排序的 `list`/`stream` 不是流式内存友好的，会一次性把结果集载入内存。比较函数返回非 `number` 或 `NaN` 会抛 `StorageError(EXTENSION_FAILED, { extensionStage: 'comparator', operation: 'entity.orderBy' })`。

`onInvalid`：取 `'skip'`（默认）、`'throw'`，或 `(issue) => 'skip' | 'throw'` 处理器函数；`issue.stage` 标识失败发生在解码（`decode`）、迁移（`migrate`）还是校验（`validate`）阶段。处理器返回非 `'skip'`/`'throw'` 为 `INVALID_CONFIG`；handler 自身的普通失败按 `VALIDATION_FAILED` 包装，已有 storage-family 错误保持其码与原因链。issue.stage 是记录失败阶段，不决定 handler 错误码。

扫描策略：KV-only 后端（local/session/cookie）会对全部键做一次 `keys()` 扫描后按 `entityName:` 前缀过滤，并调用一次 `onDiagnostic`（`"...list/stream on a value-only backend performs a full key scan"`）——这不是 bug，是这类后端固有的能力限制。结构化后端（IndexedDB/memory）按 entity 的 v2 前缀 range 高效扫描一遍，再额外扫描一遍全表以兼容尚未迁移的历史形态记录（`[entityName, id]`），用 `seenIds` 去重避免同一记录在两次扫描中都被 yield。
`list` 是 `stream` 的缓冲版本（`for await` 收集进数组后返回）；两者共享同一套过滤/排序/`onInvalid` 逻辑。

blocks.text: 批量把库中全部记录升级到当前 entity `version`（同时把历史存储形态的记录搬迁为 v2 key 形态）。返回值各字段：`scanned`（扫描到的记录总数）、`eligible`（版本低于当前、需要迁移的记录数）、`migrated`（成功迁移的记录数）、`skipped`（因 `onInvalid` 策略被跳过的坏记录数）、`alreadyCurrent`（扫描时已经是当前版本，无需迁移）、`conflicted`（结构化后端事务提交冲突后，逐条重试仍失败/让位给并发写入的记录数）。

items: 断点续跑：仅 IndexedDB 提供 `metadata` 通道，可在 `` `repository:${name}:migration` `` key 下持久化检查点（`status`/`phase`/`scanned`/`migrated`/... 等全部计数器 + `lastPhysicalKey`），跨调用恢复——上次迁移中途失败或被取消，下次调用 `migrate()` 会从检查点继续，而不是从头重新扫描。检查点是否可复用取决于一个“迁移指纹”（entity 名、版本、主键属性名、schema 名、codec 名、迁移函数版本号集合的拼接）是否与本次调用一致，指纹不匹配视为过期检查点，从头开始。`memoryStorageHost`/KV-only 后端没有 `metadata` 通道，无法跨调用恢复，每次调用都从头扫描。

批量提交与冲突重试（结构化后端）：以 `batchSize` 条记录为一批，在一个 `transaction` 内批量迁移；若该批次因 `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` 整体失败，会退化为逐条在独立事务中重试——重试时会重新检查目标位置是否已被并发写入覆盖为更高版本（此时计入 `alreadyCurrent` 而非重复迁移），仍然冲突的记录计入 `conflicted`（不抛错，允许调用方后续再次调用 `migrate()` 补齐）。
记录解码/迁移/校验失败时按 `onInvalid` 策略处理，逻辑与 `list`/`stream` 一致（`skip` 计入 `skipped`，`throw` 直接抛出对应错误码并中断整个 `migrate()` 调用）。

blocks.code:
const result = await preferences.migrate({ batchSize: 200, onInvalid: 'skip' })
console.log(result.migrated, result.conflicted, result.alreadyCurrent)

conflicted: Records changed concurrently and left for later.

blocks.text: 批量把库中全部记录升级到当前 entity `version`（同时把历史存储形态的记录搬迁为 v2 key 形态）。返回值各字段：`scanned`（扫描到的记录总数）、`eligible`（版本低于当前、需要迁移的记录数）、`migrated`（成功迁移的记录数）、`skipped`（因 `onInvalid` 策略被跳过的坏记录数）、`alreadyCurrent`（扫描时已经是当前版本，无需迁移）、`conflicted`（结构化后端事务提交冲突后，逐条重试仍失败/让位给并发写入的记录数）。

items: 断点续跑：仅 IndexedDB 提供 `metadata` 通道，可在 `` `repository:${name}:migration` `` key 下持久化检查点（`status`/`phase`/`scanned`/`migrated`/... 等全部计数器 + `lastPhysicalKey`），跨调用恢复——上次迁移中途失败或被取消，下次调用 `migrate()` 会从检查点继续，而不是从头重新扫描。检查点是否可复用取决于一个“迁移指纹”（entity 名、版本、主键属性名、schema 名、codec 名、迁移函数版本号集合的拼接）是否与本次调用一致，指纹不匹配视为过期检查点，从头开始。`memoryStorageHost`/KV-only 后端没有 `metadata` 通道，无法跨调用恢复，每次调用都从头扫描。

批量提交与冲突重试（结构化后端）：以 `batchSize` 条记录为一批，在一个 `transaction` 内批量迁移；若该批次因 `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` 整体失败，会退化为逐条在独立事务中重试——重试时会重新检查目标位置是否已被并发写入覆盖为更高版本（此时计入 `alreadyCurrent` 而非重复迁移），仍然冲突的记录计入 `conflicted`（不抛错，允许调用方后续再次调用 `migrate()` 补齐）。
记录解码/迁移/校验失败时按 `onInvalid` 策略处理，逻辑与 `list`/`stream` 一致（`skip` 计入 `skipped`，`throw` 直接抛出对应错误码并中断整个 `migrate()` 调用）。

const result = await preferences.migrate({ batchSize: 200, onInvalid: 'skip' })
console.log(result.migrated, result.conflicted, result.alreadyCurrent)

  plugins: [indexedDbReactive({ id: 'primary', dbName: 'app-data' })] as const

const handle = host.reactiveBackend('primary')

  backendId: 'primary',
  runtime,
  scope: 'users',
  query: ({ store, signal }) => store.getRecord(['users', 'ada'], { signal }),

})

await query.dispose()
await host.dispose()

symbols.signature: export declare class StorageHostFacade<TStores extends Record<string, IKeyValueStore> = Record<never, never>, TReactiveIds extends keyof TStores & string = never> { #private; /** Creates the shell and snapshots lifecycle/deadline inputs before any plugin runs. */ constructor(options?: IStorageHostOptions); /** Materializes one immutable plugin tuple through the canonical PluginHost batch. */ use<const TPlugins extends readonly IStorageBackendPluginHandle[]>(...plugins: IRejectInstalledOrDuplicateIds<TStores, TPlugins>): Promise<IStorageHost<TStores & IPluginStoreMap<TPlugins>, TReactiveIds | IStoragePluginReactiveId<TPlugins[number]>, IStoragePluginExtensions<TPlugins[number]>>>; /** Returns the current immutable extension plane after its corresponding batch has committed. */ get extensions(): Readonly<Record<PropertyKey, unknown>>; /** Looks up an exact store from the last atomically published registry snapshot. */ backend<TId extends keyof TStores & string>(id: TId): TStores[TId]; /** Narrows a lookup to IDs in the current immutable registry snapshot. */ hasBackend(id: string): id is keyof TStores & string; /** Return a detached Map copy, typed readonly; mutating the copy cannot change this registry. */ backends(): ReadonlyMap<keyof TStores & string, TStores[keyof TStores]>; /** Reports whether the committed Host registry contains an exact reactive adapter. */ hasReactiveBackend(id: string): id is TReactiveIds; /** Returns exact adapter-bound store shell and delegates query state to Resource. */ reactiveBackend<TId extends keyof TStores & string>(id: TId): IReactiveBackendHandle<TStores[TId], TId> | undefined; /** Seals the facade once and delegates lifecycle cleanup to PluginHost. */ dispose(): Promise<void>; }
symbols.purpose: The host class used by `createStorageHost`; constructing it directly gives an empty host to fill with `await host.use(plugin)`.
symbols.core:
A new empty StorageHostFacade with snapped scheduler and installation budget; no backend is installed by construction. Install backend plugins through use() and await dispose() at the end of its lifetime.
extensions: APIs added by installed plugins (custom `definePlugin` installs).
use: Installs more plugins after creation; the whole batch is published atomically or rolled back. A second `use()` during installation throws `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`.
use.plugins: Plugin handles with new, unique ids.
The same host, typed with the new backends.
backend: Returns the store installed under an id.
backend.id: Id given to the plugin (`memoryBackendPlugin({ id })`).
The store; unknown ids throw `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`.
hasBackend: Tells whether an id is installed (also narrows its type).
hasBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when installed.
backends: Returns a copied map of all installed stores by id; its ReadonlyMap type prevents typed mutation, but the map is not frozen at runtime.
A fresh `ReadonlyMap<string, IKeyValueStore>`; mutating the copy never changes host registrations.
hasReactiveBackend: Tells whether an id has a reactive adapter.
hasReactiveBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when reactive.
reactiveBackend: Returns the reactive handle of an id: `{ id, store, liveQuery }`.
reactiveBackend.id: Id of a backend installed with a `*Reactive` plugin.
An `IReactiveBackendHandle`; non-reactive ids throw `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_NOT_INSTALLED`.
dispose: Stops admission, cancels an installation in progress, waits for running work, then releases adapters and stores. Repeated calls share one Promise; afterwards every call throws `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`.
Resolves when released; cleanup errors are aggregated.
liveQuery: Only with reactive backends: creates a live query; see `ILiveQueryOptions`.
liveQuery.options: `{ backendId, runtime, query, ... }`.
An `ILiveQuery`.
installTimeoutMs: Deadline of one installation batch.
`30000`.
scheduler: Clock for installation and cleanup.
`systemScheduler`.
report: Receives late rejections and cleanup diagnostics.
Not set.
symbols.advanced: Create an empty host and install backends later.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
A new empty StorageHostFacade with snapped scheduler and installation budget; no backend is installed by construction. Install backend plugins through use() and await dispose() at the end of its lifetime.
extensions: APIs added by installed plugins (custom `definePlugin` installs).
use: Installs more plugins after creation; the whole batch is published atomically or rolled back. A second `use()` during installation throws `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`.
use.plugins: Plugin handles with new, unique ids.
The same host, typed with the new backends.
backend: Returns the store installed under an id.
backend.id: Id given to the plugin (`memoryBackendPlugin({ id })`).
The store; unknown ids throw `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`.
hasBackend: Tells whether an id is installed (also narrows its type).
hasBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when installed.
backends: Returns a copied map of all installed stores by id; its ReadonlyMap type prevents typed mutation, but the map is not frozen at runtime.
A fresh `ReadonlyMap<string, IKeyValueStore>`; mutating the copy never changes host registrations.
hasReactiveBackend: Tells whether an id has a reactive adapter.
hasReactiveBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when reactive.
reactiveBackend: Returns the reactive handle of an id: `{ id, store, liveQuery }`.
reactiveBackend.id: Id of a backend installed with a `*Reactive` plugin.
An `IReactiveBackendHandle`; non-reactive ids throw `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_NOT_INSTALLED`.
dispose: Stops admission, cancels an installation in progress, waits for running work, then releases adapters and stores. Repeated calls share one Promise; afterwards every call throws `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`.
Resolves when released; cleanup errors are aggregated.
liveQuery: Only with reactive backends: creates a live query; see `ILiveQueryOptions`.
liveQuery.options: `{ backendId, runtime, query, ... }`.
An `ILiveQuery`.
installTimeoutMs: Deadline of one installation batch.
`30000`.
scheduler: Clock for installation and cleanup.
`systemScheduler`.
report: Receives late rejections and cleanup diagnostics.
Not set.

blocks.text: `StorageHostFacade` 是 `createStorageHost()` 使用的同一 Host shell，不是另一套运行时。直接构造只创建空 Host，之后用 `await host.use(plugin)` 安装 backend；需要在返回前原子安装首批 plugins 时优先使用 `createStorageHost({ plugins })`。

构造参数与 factory 共用同一契约：`installTimeoutMs` 限制完整安装 batch，`scheduler` 注入生命周期时间，`report` 只接收 late rejection 和 cleanup 诊断且不会替换主错误。`backend()`、`hasBackend()`、`backends()`、`use()` 和 `dispose()` 的行为与 factory 返回对象完全一致。

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates an IndexedDB store with values, bytes, records, transactions, iteration and secondary indexes. The connection opens once and yields to version upgrades from other tabs. `ensureRecordIndexes` races shared opening against the operation deadline through `raceWithAbort`; stopping one waiter leaves shared preparation owned by the backend. `iterateRecordIndex` uses one deadline across the whole iterator, including buffered yields, and releases its abort subscription and timer in finally when iteration completes or the consumer calls return.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates a namespaced `localStorage` store with async and `sync` APIs. A probe write at creation detects private-mode failures early (`BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`).

items: `namespace?: string` —— 默认 `'default'`。构造期校验：必须是非空字符串，否则抛 `StorageError(INVALID_CONFIG)`。同命名空间内的 `keys()`/`clearValues()`/`clearAll()` 互相隔离，不同命名空间的同名 key 互不影响。
`namespaceCodec?: INamespaceCodec` —— 默认 `lengthPrefixedNamespaceCodec`（见契约与能力模块）。构造期用 `snapshotNamespaceCodec` 校验 `encode`/`decode` 均为函数，否则抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`。

`storage?: IWebStorageLike` —— 注入点，默认 `globalThis.localStorage`。传入的对象必须实现 `getItem`/`setItem`/`removeItem`/`key`/`clear` 方法与 `length: number`（非负安全整数），否则抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`；读取 `options.storage` 本身抛错（例如 getter 抛异常）也会被捕获并归一化为 `INVALID_CONFIG`。

blocks.text: `IWebStorageLike`：

blocks.code:
type IWebStorageLike = {
  readonly length: number
  getItem(key: string): string | null
  setItem(key: string, value: string): void
  removeItem(key: string): void
  clear(): void
  key(index: number): string | null
}

blocks.text: 构造期探测：`createWebStorageBackend` 在返回 store 前，会用 `probeWebStorage` 真实写一次探测 key（`namespacedKey(namespace, '__probe__', ...)`）再删除/还原。Safari 隐私模式下 `localStorageHost` 对象存在但 `setItem` 抛异常（旧版本 `SecurityError`，新版本 quota=0 的 `QuotaExceededError`），只有真实写入才能可靠探测到这种情况；探测失败立即抛 `StorageError(BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE)`，而不是等到第一次业务写入才发现。若探测 key 原本已存在非空值，探测会退避到一个带时间戳/随机数后缀的临时 key，避免覆盖调用方数据。
能力（`store.capabilities`，`Object.freeze` 恒定值）：

blocks.code:
{
  syncRead: true,
  binary: false,
  records: false,
  transactions: false,
  iteration: false,
  secondaryIndexes: false,
  changeFeed: false,
  maxValueBytes: 5 * 1024 * 1024, // 近似上限，不是精确配额
  opaqueEntries: false
}

blocks.text: 返回类型：`ISyncCapableStore<IKeyValueStore>`，即 `IKeyValueStore` 且 `sync` 字段恒非 `undefined`。`get`/`set`/`remove`/`has`/`keys`/`clearValues` 是对应 `sync.*` 方法的 `withAbort` 包装，先检查取消，再同步执行底层操作并返回 `Promise`；`clearAll` 与 `dispose` 是异步专有入口。
`sync` 通道方法：

items: `get(key)`：物理 key 不存在返回 `null`。宿主 `getItem` 抛错（例如配额/隐私模式变化）经 `normalizeStorageException` 归一化：quota 类异常 → `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`，其余 → `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`。
`set(key, value, options?)`：`value` 必须是 `string`，否则抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`（不做隐式 `String()` 转换）。写入失败按上文规则归一化异常。
`remove(key)`：物理 key 不存在时静默成功（幂等）。
`has(key)`：等价于 `getItem(...) !== null`。
`keys()`：枚举该命名空间下全部逻辑键。内部校验宿主 `length`、`key(index)` 及重复物理 key；内部 coded `TypeError` 在公开 `sync.keys()` 出口归一化为 `StorageError`，原断言异常保留在 cause。
`clearValues()`：只删除该命名空间下的键；先拍一份稳定的物理键快照再逐个删除，若中途某个 `removeItem` 抛错，会带上该键的 `logicalKey` 抛出，暴露精确的部分失败边界。

blocks.text: 异步专有方法：

items: `clearAll(ctx?)`：与 `clearValues` 等价（本后端没有独立于命名空间之外的额外数据）。
`dispose()`：backend reactive controller 封闭新接纳，等待 mutation leases 并清理订阅/资源；此后方法调用抛 `StorageContractError(STORE_DISPOSED)`。不清空宿主存储数据。

const store = localStorageHost({ namespace: 'settings' })

console.log(await store.get('theme')) // 'dark'

console.log(store.sync.get('theme')) // 'light'
await store.remove('theme')
console.log(await store.has('theme')) // false
await store.dispose()

class StorageError extends Error {
  readonly source: '@migaia/storage-web'
  readonly code: IStorageErrorCode
  readonly backend?: IBackendKind
  readonly key?: string | IStorageKey
  readonly existingChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
  readonly attemptedChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
  readonly extensionStage?: 'schema' | 'codec' | 'migration' | 'comparator' | 'diagnostic'
  readonly operation?: string
  constructor(
    code: IStorageErrorCode,
    details?: {
      readonly backend?: IBackendKind
      readonly key?: string | IStorageKey
      readonly existingChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
      readonly attemptedChannel?: 'value' | 'bytes' | 'record'
      readonly extensionStage?: 'schema' | 'codec' | 'migration' | 'comparator' | 'diagnostic'
      readonly operation?: string
      readonly cause?: unknown
    },
    message?: string
  )
}

blocks.text: `source` 恒为 `'@migaia/storage-web'`；`cause` 恒保留原始异常，永不改写 `message`；实例在构造后立即 `Object.freeze`。
`STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE` 是上述稳定 source 的唯一公开常量。`StorageErrorText` 是包维护的稳定错误文本/文本工厂集合，主要供实现自定义 backend、codec 或诊断适配器时复用；业务分支仍应比较 `(source, code)`，不要依赖 message 文本。
全部错误码（`StorageErrorCode`）：

rows: 存储后端不可用：隐私模式探测失败、`localStorageHost`/IndexedDB/`document` 被禁用或缺失
写入命中浏览器配额上限
序列化后的 cookie 值超过单值 4KB 上限
序列化失败（`JSON.stringify` 抛错、codec encode 非预期输出、`structuredClone` 写失败）
反序列化失败（`JSON.parse` 抛错、envelope 结构非法、codec decode 非预期输出）
IndexedDB 事务创建/提交失败，或事务回调抛出非 `StorageError` 异常
value/bytes/record 三通道逻辑 key 冲突且未指定 `conflictPolicy: 'replace'`
entity envelope `__v` 或 IndexedDB schema 版本高于当前代码所知的版本
扩展点（schema/codec/namespaceCodec/comparator/diagnostic）抛出了未归类的异常
事务提交时 read revision 或 global epoch 已变（并发写冲突，可重试）
Cookie 写入后读回不可见
Cookie 同名多 scope 可见，无法确定目标值归属
Web adapter 专有输入/配置校验失败（选项形状、cookie scope、IndexedDB store 名等）

blocks.text: 批量把库中全部记录升级到当前 entity `version`（同时把历史存储形态的记录搬迁为 v2 key 形态）。返回值各字段：`scanned`（扫描到的记录总数）、`eligible`（版本低于当前、需要迁移的记录数）、`migrated`（成功迁移的记录数）、`skipped`（因 `onInvalid` 策略被跳过的坏记录数）、`alreadyCurrent`（扫描时已经是当前版本，无需迁移）、`conflicted`（结构化后端事务提交冲突后，逐条重试仍失败/让位给并发写入的记录数）。

items: 断点续跑：仅 IndexedDB 提供 `metadata` 通道，可在 `` `repository:${name}:migration` `` key 下持久化检查点（`status`/`phase`/`scanned`/`migrated`/... 等全部计数器 + `lastPhysicalKey`），跨调用恢复——上次迁移中途失败或被取消，下次调用 `migrate()` 会从检查点继续，而不是从头重新扫描。检查点是否可复用取决于一个“迁移指纹”（entity 名、版本、主键属性名、schema 名、codec 名、迁移函数版本号集合的拼接）是否与本次调用一致，指纹不匹配视为过期检查点，从头开始。`memoryStorageHost`/KV-only 后端没有 `metadata` 通道，无法跨调用恢复，每次调用都从头扫描。

批量提交与冲突重试（结构化后端）：以 `batchSize` 条记录为一批，在一个 `transaction` 内批量迁移；若该批次因 `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` 整体失败，会退化为逐条在独立事务中重试——重试时会重新检查目标位置是否已被并发写入覆盖为更高版本（此时计入 `alreadyCurrent` 而非重复迁移），仍然冲突的记录计入 `conflicted`（不抛错，允许调用方后续再次调用 `migrate()` 补齐）。
记录解码/迁移/校验失败时按 `onInvalid` 策略处理，逻辑与 `list`/`stream` 一致（`skip` 计入 `skipped`，`throw` 直接抛出对应错误码并中断整个 `migrate()` 调用）。

blocks.code:
const result = await preferences.migrate({ batchSize: 200, onInvalid: 'skip' })
console.log(result.migrated, result.conflicted, result.alreadyCurrent)

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Plugin that installs a `document.cookie` store under an id and also its reactive adapter (hybrid / origin-js-visible-eventual), so the host gains `liveQuery` for that id.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import cookiesReactive from @migaia/storage-web/plugins/reactive/cookies, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use cookiesReactive when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when cookiesReactive does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
A plugin handle for `createStorageHost({ plugins })` or `host.use()`.
id: Caller-selected backend registration id; use this exact value with `host.backend()` and live-query `backendId`.
Omitted: register under `cookies`.
After installation `host.backend("cookies")` returns the store, `host.reactiveBackend("cookies")` returns its reactive handle, and `host.liveQuery({ backendId: "cookies", ... })` keeps a query fresh when the store changes.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Disposing the host disposes the store and, for reactive plugins, its adapter.
Update the UI automatically when stored data changes.

examples:
import { createRuntime } from '@migaia/reactive'
import { createStorageHost } from '@migaia/storage-web/host'
import { indexedDbReactive } from '@migaia/storage-web/plugins/reactive/indexed-db'

const runtime = createRuntime()
const host = await createStorageHost({
  plugins: [indexedDbReactive({ id: 'primary', dbName: 'app-data' })] as const
})

const handle = host.reactiveBackend('primary')
const query = host.liveQuery({
  backendId: 'primary',
  runtime,
  scope: 'users',
  query: ({ store, signal }) => store.getRecord(['users', 'ada'], { signal }),
  matches: (change) => change.scope === 'users',
  keepPreviousData: true,
  timeoutMs: 5_000,
  report: (error) => console.error('late reactive failure', error)
})

await query.ready
console.log(query.state.value)
await query.refresh()
await query.dispose()
await host.dispose()

symbols.identity: packages/storage-web/dist/schema/standard-schema.d.ts:fromStandardSchema:export declare const fromStandardSchema: <T>(schema: IStandardSchemaV1<unknown, T>) => ISchemaAdapter<T, T>;

blocks.code: function fromStandardSchema<T>(schema: IStandardSchemaV1<unknown, T>): ISchemaAdapter<T, T>

blocks.text: 单参数 `schema`（必填），无选项。适配任意实现 Standard Schema v1 规范的库（zod ≥3.24、valibot ≥1.0、arktype ≥2.0）——本包不 import 任何一家，也不把它们列为 peerDependency，只依赖 `schema['~standard']` 上的 `version`/`vendor`/`validate` 三个字段。

items: 构造期校验：`schema` 必须是对象；`schema['~standard']` 必须是对象且 `version === 1`、`vendor` 是非空字符串、`validate` 是函数，否则抛 `StorageError(INVALID_CONFIG)`。
`validate(value)` 内部调用 `schema['~standard'].validate(value)`（同步或异步均可）：
返回值本身非对象/`null`/数组，抛 `VALIDATION_FAILED`。
返回带 `issues` 数组：逐条读取 `.message`（必须是 `string`），拼接所有 `; ` 分隔的消息，作为 `cause.message` 抛 `StorageError(VALIDATION_FAILED)`。
返回带 `value` 字段且无 `issues`：作为校验结果返回。
既无 `issues` 也无 `value`：抛 `VALIDATION_FAILED`（“Standard Schema result must contain value or issues”）。
`name` 为 `` `standard-schema:${vendor}` ``（例如 `'standard-schema:zod'`）。

blocks.text: 按版本升序执行迁移函数链，独立于 entity 层可单独调用。

items: `value`（必填）：待迁移的原始值。
`fromVersion`/`toVersion`（必填）：均为非负安全整数，否则抛 `StorageError(INVALID_CONFIG)`。
`migrations?`：`Record<number, IMigration>`；若提供必须是普通对象（非数组），否则抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`。
`signal?`：可选取消信号，逐个迁移步骤之间检查取消状态。
`fromVersion >= toVersion` 时直接原样返回 `value`，不调用任何迁移函数。
每个版本号（`fromVersion + 1` 到 `toVersion`）依次检查 `migrations[version]`：缺失该版本对应的迁移函数视为该版本没有数据形状变化（no-op），不是错误——这一点与 `defineEntity` 的迁移图构造期校验（要求每一步都存在）不同，`runMigrations` 单独调用时更宽容。存在但非函数类型抛 `INVALID_CONFIG`。

items: `codec`（必填）：经 `snapshotCodec` 校验为合法的 `ICodec` 描述符（`name`/`output`/`encode`/`decode` 齐备），否则抛契约级 `INVALID_ARGUMENT`。

blocks.text: 选路规则：

1. `codec.output === 'structured'`：`capabilities.records === false` 时抛 `StorageContractError(UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY)`（structured clone 能力无法用 JSON 表达，不做隐式转换以避免丢数据）；否则返回四字段 codec 快照，函数引用保持。 2. `codec.output === 'binary'`：`capabilities.binary === true` 时直连；`false` 时自动降级为 base64 文本（体积 +33%），调用一次 `onDiagnostic(message)` 报告降级，返回一个包装过的 `ISelectedCodec`（`encode` 内部转 `bytesToBase64`，`decode` 内部转 `base64ToBytes` 再交给原 codec）。 3. 其余情况（`output === 'text'`，或已经匹配能力的 `binary`/`structured`）返回四字段浅快照；容器不是原 codec，不保留额外字段或旧 receiver 绑定。

configuration.name: namespaceCodec
configuration.description: 默认物理 key 编码器（`localStorageHost`/`sessionStorageHost`/`cookiesHost` 的 `namespaceCodec` 默认值）。编码格式：`sw1:<命名空间 UTF-8 字节长度>:<encodeURIComponent(命名空间)>:<key>`——长度前缀 + 编码后的命名空间共同防止“命名空间 A 的 key 恰好是命名空间 B 前缀”这种碰撞。`decode` 只在物理 key 精确匹配该命名空间时返回原始逻辑 key，否则返回 `undefined`（不属于该命名空间，调用方应跳过而非报错）。
configuration.descriptionEn: Customizes physical key encoding. Changing the codec changes the persistence format.
configuration.descriptionZh: 默认物理 key 编码器（`localStorageHost`/`sessionStorageHost`/`cookiesHost` 的 `namespaceCodec` 默认值）。编码格式：`sw1:<命名空间 UTF-8 字节长度>:<encodeURIComponent(命名空间)>:<key>`——长度前缀 + 编码后的命名空间共同防止“命名空间 A 的 key 恰好是命名空间 B 前缀”这种碰撞。`decode` 只在物理 key 精确匹配该命名空间时返回原始逻辑 key，否则返回 `undefined`（不属于该命名空间，调用方应跳过而非报错）。
